newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Jubail oil refinery maintenance in November.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Jubail oil refinery maintenance in November.

text.p: The 305,000 barrels per day (bpd) Jubail refinery will be shut for about a month from November to carry out scheduled maintenance work, oil industry sources in Saudi Arabia said on Monday.
The main part of the 30-day shutdown focuses on changing the catalyst at the plant's hydrocracker, they said.
Products from the plant's throughput of Arab Light crude are typically exported to southeast Asia.
Market sources expected the maintenance work to cap exports of fuel oil and middle distillates.
Jubail is operated by Saudi Aramco Shell Refinery Company (Sasref), a joint venture between state oil firm Aramco and Royal Dutch Shell Group.
A fire disrupted operations in August. It was not immediately known precisely when the November shutdown will begin. -- Steven Swindells, Dubai Newsroom, +971 4 6071255
